hack.root_cause: Donation Attack → Supply Cap Bypass → Collateral Inflation → Recursive Borrow Loop
hack.description: An attacker spent 9 months accumulating 84% of Venus Protocol's THE supply cap, bypassed it via a raw ERC-20 transfer (an exploit flagged and dismissed by Venus's own Code4rena audit in 2023), and extracted $3.7M — Venus's fourth major hack in five years, same root cause category each time.
